site_name: LAND AT THE FORMER BELL GREEN GAS WORKS, BELL GREEN, LONDON, SE26

building_details.building_ref: Building Plot 1 (Blocks A, B and C)

description: Development comprising the phased construction of three building plots (comprising 6no blocks) ranging in height between 6 and 14 storeys, accommodating flexible retail and workspace floorspace units (Use Class E) at ground floor level, together with residential units (Use Class C3), with associated public realm, landscaping, amenity space, cycle parking, car parking, plant and associated works at Land at the Former Bell Green Gas Works, London, SE26. This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement and further information (submitted 21/12/2023) is available to view in relation to the Environmental Statement which had already been provided.
